questions.title: Container vs VM
questions.question: What is the difference between a Docker container and a virtual machine?
searchIntent: difference between container and virtual machine
questions.realWorldScenario: One of the first Docker interview questions — containers share the OS kernel and start in milliseconds.

questions.title: Docker Image vs Container
questions.question: What is the difference between a Docker image and a Docker container?
searchIntent: what is a Docker image vs container
questions.realWorldScenario: The most fundamental Docker concept — image is a class, container is an instance.

questions.title: Docker Run Command
questions.question: What does the docker run command do? Explain port mapping (-p), environment variables (-e), and volumes (-v).
searchIntent: docker run port mapping environment variables
questions.realWorldScenario: Running a PostgreSQL container locally for development: docker run -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret -p 5432:5432 postgres

questions.title: Docker Hub and Registries
questions.question: What is Docker Hub? What does 'pulling an image' mean?
questions.realWorldScenario: Pulling the official postgres:16 or openjdk:21-slim image to use as a base.

questions.title: Docker Image Layers
questions.question: What are Docker image layers and how does layer caching speed up builds?
questions.realWorldScenario: COPY dependencies before COPY source code in Dockerfile so dependency layer is cached unless pom.xml changes.
